hooks.command: which gortex >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"gortex CLI not found on PATH. Install: brew install gortex or cargo install gortex. gortex tools disabled."}'

[ -f .gortex.yaml ] || exit 0; case "%tool%" in read|grep|find) printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Repo is Gortex-indexed. Use gortex_search / gortex_read / gortex_explore instead of %tool%.\"}' ;; bash) if printf '%s' "%command%" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:];&])(rg|grep)([[:space:];&]|$)'; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Repo is Gortex-indexed. Use gortex_search / gortex_read / gortex_explore instead of grep-style bash.\"}'; else exit 0; fi ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
